description: This file contains source code for telemetry data processing, including log parsing, pattern matching, and data aggregation functions. It interfaces with system logs, message bus, and telemetry nodes, and includes functions for JSON and vector output, error handling, and synchronization.

methods.name: processTopPattern
methods.description: Processes log file patterns to retrieve load average and process usage, updating the grep result list.

methods.name: appendData
methods.description: Appends or copies data to a telemetry node.

methods.name: processTr181Objects
methods.description: Processes tr181 objects via ccsp message bus, retrieving parameter values and handling multi-instance objects.

methods.name: addToJson
methods.description: Adds pattern data to a JSON search result object.

methods.name: addToVector
methods.description: Adds pattern data to a vector of grep results.

methods.name: getSplitParameterValue
methods.description: Extracts value from a log line based on a split pattern.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts RDK error code from a string.

methods.name: handleRDKErrCodes
methods.description: Handles RDK error codes found in log lines, updating error code list.

methods.name: processCountPattern
methods.description: Processes log lines for pattern counts, updating node counts and handling RDK error codes.

methods.name: processPattern
methods.description: Main function to process log files based on pattern type, including top, message bus, or count patterns.

methods.name: strSplit
methods.description: Splits a string based on a delimiter, similar to strstr but with stateful static pointer.

methods.name: getDType
methods.description: Determines data type for a node based on filename and marker type.

methods.name: parseMarkerList
methods.description: Main logic to parse sorted vector list and process pattern list, managing log seek positions and pattern matching.

methods.name: getDCAResultsInJson
methods.description: Retrieves DCA results as JSON for a given profile and marker list, with synchronization.

methods.name: getDCAResultsInVector
methods.description: Retrieves DCA results as vector for a given profile and marker list, with synchronization.

methods.name: freeGResult
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a grep result object.
